skills.name: Kamikura Bojin
lines: Gives Barrier to all party members that reduces 5000 or less damage to 0 (until the end of turn)
* Also works against Fixed damage and percent of HP attacks.
* Replaces the basic attack from the start of battle.
* Reverts to basic attack after each use
* Becomes available again after 15 Pierce moves have been used by party members.
** Moves count starts from turn when this skill was used. Party members who acted before this skill are also counted.
** Multi-move skills alike Copy status are counted twice.
** Counters, End of Turn Attacks do not count.

skills.name: Another Zone
lines: Awakens any Elemental Type Zones or a Damage Type Attack Zones or some Hybrid Zones:
* Applicable Hybrid Zones are Double Strike Stance Attack Zones, & Moonlight Stance
* Doubles damage multiplicators for Zones:
** to +60% for Attack Zones and Thunder, Crystal, Shade (other elements) Type Zones
** to +100% for Fire, Water, Wind, Earth and Shade Type Zones
** Doubles "damage on weakness/resist" effects for Crystal/Shade Type Zone respectively
* Zone cannot be overwritten by other zones during the duration and duration cannot be extended by attempting to reactivate Another Zone
* Zone can still be removed/broken by skills that remove zones
* After duration ends, zone is removed
* Support Effects can be used at the same time as Another Zone
* Via active skills, can be activated only once per character
** When there is no appropriate zone or the zone is already awakened, using a skill that can awaken Zone will not consume awakening ability
** Non-active skill sources may activate it more than once per battle if explicitly stated

skills.name: Yuki-snowgirl State
lines: Change into Yuki-snowgirl form (3 turns):
* Intelligence of user +100% while changed.
* All buffs, debuffs, statuses from skills are erased from user on change.
* Equipment buffs with icon still apply
* Cannot act and immune to damage/buffs/debuffs/status effects.
* In the End of Turn: Yuki-snowgirl Attack / Cool Yuki-snowgirl Attack / Ultra Yuki-snowgirl Attack based on activation skill.
* In the End of Turn (after attack): Stack 1 Snow Flurry Stack
* State ends when attacked or when duration ends.
